shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'dashboard|charts|navigation' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && rg -n -C 2 'brand|base-background|base-float|spacing|border-radius' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit version peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version peerDependencies'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit@10 @gravity-ui/charts@1 @gravity-ui/navigation@7 @gravity-ui/icons@2 @bem-react/classname'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -Ls https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html && rg -o '\"(Chart["'^" ]*|Layout[''^" ]*|Gear[''^" ]*|Bell[''^" ]*|Plus[''^" ]*|Arrow[''^" ]*|Grip[''^" ]*|Calendar[''^" ]*|Persons[''^" ]*|Folder[''^" ]*|Magnifier[''^" ]*|Ellipsis[''^" ]*|CircleQuestion[''^" ]*)"'"' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | sort -u | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const p of ['dashkit','charts','navigation','icons']) { const j=require('@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json'); console.log(p,j.version,JSON.stringify(j.peerDependencies)); }\" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg '(INDEX.md|types.d.ts|AsideHeader.d.ts|Chart.d.ts|DashKit.d.ts|\\.css"'$)'"' | head -65 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components | rg '/(Button|Select|Modal|TextInput|DropdownMenu|Checkbox|Table)/.*d.ts"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); for(const p of ['dashkit','charts','navigation','icons']) {const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json'));console.log(p,j.version,JSON.stringify(j.peerDependencies));}\" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/icons').then(r=>r.text()).then(s=>require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/gravity-icons.html',s))\" && rg -o '(Chart|Layout|Gear|Bell|Plus|Arrow|Grip|Calendar|Persons|Folder|Magnifier|Ellipsis|CircleQuestion)[A-Za-z]+' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | sort -u | head -70 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '/(Button|Select|Modal|TextInput|DropdownMenu|Checkbox|Table)/.*d.ts"'$'"' | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts && rg -n -A 65 '(interface (Plugin|Settings|ConfigItem)|type (Plugin|Settings|ConfigItem)|gridLayout|PluginWidgetProps)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts && rg -n -A 100 'interface AsideHeaderProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs | rg '(area|pie|line|theming|axis)' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/area.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/pie.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | rg '/(area|line|pie|chart|axis)/.*types.d.ts"'$'"' && rg -n '\"exports\"|css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o 'data-icon["'^>]+|aria-label="[''^"]+"|title="[''^"]+"'"' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | head -25 && rg 'export.*(Chart|Layout|Gear|Bell|Plus|Arrow|Grip|Calendar|Persons|Folder|Magnifier|Ellipsis|CircleQuestion|Sliders|Square|Bars|Chevrons|Xmark|Check|Circle)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/dist/esm/index.d.ts | head -80 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -55 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts && rg -n -A 125 '(interface AsideHeaderProps|type AsideHeaderProps)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && rg -n -A 55 '(Plugin|Settings|Renderer)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/plugin.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/settings.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | rg '(types/(chart|series|axis|axes)|types.d.ts)' | tail -40 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md && rg -n -C 2 'aside-header|menu-item|background|width' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader/README.md | head -100 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg 'index.d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,135p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/common.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/config.d.ts && rg -n '(Chart|Layout|Gear|Bell|Plus|Arrow|Grip|Calendar|Persons|Folder|Magnifier|Ellipsis|CircleQuestion|Sliders|Square|Bars|Chevrons|Xmark|Check|Wallet|Shopping|Copy|Trash|Floppy)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -85"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/area.d.ts && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts && rg -n -A 10 'visible|grid|tick|labels|categories|min\\?|max\\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -140 && rg -n -C 2 'css|width|background|current|renderFooter|renderSubheader' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/README.md | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '(Chart|Layout|Gear|Plus|Grip|Persons|Folder|Magnifier|Ellipsis|CircleQuestion|Sliders|Square|Xmark|Check|Wallet|Shopping|Copy|Trash|Floppy|Target|CircleInfo|ArrowDownToLine)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | tail -65 && rg -o -- '--[a-zA-Z0-9-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.module.scss.js | sort -u | head -70 && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && sed -n '1,115p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && rg -n -A 28 'type LogoProps|interface LogoProps|interface MenuItem' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg 'as (ChartLine|ChartColumn|ChartPie|LayoutCells|Gear|Grip|GripVertical|Ellipsis|CircleQuestion|CircleInfo|Copy|Check|FloppyDisk|FileText|Database|CircleCheck|ArrowDownRight)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts && sed -n '1,95p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/types.d.ts && rg -n 'grid|visible|tickInterval|tickAmount|style\\?|format\\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && rg -n -A 12 'interface ChartData|interface ChartProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/Chart/*.d.ts && rg -n 'interpolation|dashStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts && rg -n 'item.*(background|color)|current.*color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/MenuItem/MenuItem.css"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'grid|visible|tickInterval|tickAmount|style\\?|format\\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; rg -n -A 18 'interface ChartData|interface ChartProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/Chart/*.d.ts; rg -n 'interpolation|dashStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts; rg -n 'item.*(background|color)|current.*color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/MenuItem/MenuItem.css; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/MobileLayout/MobileLayout.js"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'setSettings|isMobile' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/settings.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/MobileLayout/MobileLayout.css; rg -n -- '--gn-.*(current|selected|item).*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/*/*.css | head -25; rg -n -- '--g-table-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -30; cat index.html; cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"})[kind]}\",\"} as Record<string, string>)[kind]}\")
s=s.replace(\"value={data.text || ''}\",\"value={typeof data.text === 'string' ? data.text : ''}\")
s=s.replace(\"useEffect(() => {DashKit.setSettings({isMobile: narrow});}, [narrow]);\", \"useMemo(() => {DashKit.setSettings({isMobile: narrow});}, [narrow]);\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm | rg '(MenuItem.*css|Current.*css|current.*css|density.js"'$)'"'; rg -n 'isMobile|setSettings' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/*.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/managers/*.js; sed -n '225,290p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/register-manager.js; rg -n -C 3 'draggableHandleClassName|isMobile' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKitView/DashKitView.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm | rg '(Menu/|MenuItem/|Current)' | head -25; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/density.js | head -65; cat .gitignore"
